notes.title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is Out Now! ⚔️
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/f92a4d80d0acad119963abf1a4d58e667ddacae0.jpg

Greetings friends!!!
We have some great news to share with you today.

Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is now available on Steam! We are offering a special 15% discount during the launch period
The game is also available on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139840/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona/

At its core this is a Souls-like game that features Metroidvania elements, filled with exploration and secrets to be found.

You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey.

Let's celebrate the game's launch!
In honor of the release, please watch the trailer and immerse yourself in the world of Makh-Abyss before fully exploring the story and finding out what actually happened after the death of Lord Derek Ericona.

[previewyoutube=PtAhNjGXCuY;full][/previewyoutube]

Join the defense of distant frontiers aboard a battle-worn but reliable cruiser. Lead a team of young and ambitious recruits in the free ONE WAY ROAD: FIREHUNT story prologue.

notes.title: One Way Road: Firehunt. Introducing the prologue.
notes.content:
One Way Road: Firehunt is going to be released very soon. (Exact date will be announced later).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2630030/One_Way_Road_Firehunt/

As a prologue to the main story, Firehunt serves as an important narrative component of the game. You will meet the main characters, experience all gameplay mechanics, and receive a small bonus upon completion!

However, before we get into the details, let's check out the prologue gameplay trailer.

[previewyoutube=frvgBV9KHnU;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, for more details:

- The prologue will consist of 5 levels. A total of 4 main levels are included, as well as 1 bonus level that is optional for completion. Completing bonus missions in the full version of the game, will affect the plot and ending.

- The prologue will include all gameplay mechanics, such as:

Scroll Shooter - one of the fundamental mechanics of the game. As a commander, you will be in charge of a space fleet heavy cruiser. Depending on the situation, you may have to fight numerous enemies, face up to a boss, or navigate through dangerous space sectors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919814/598124ed517d7b509194ab7e183cbcf2e545abba.gif

Top down Shooter - you'll take the wheel of a small and agile assault fighter instead of the cumbersome cruiser. Faster gameplay requires lightning-fast reactions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919814/de1d3428928217e0c53311e2bbb9749bdf0e33ec.gif

Tube Shooter - Engage in third-person view pursuits that will see you shooting down both small ships and impressive cruisers, destroying their engines, weapons, and other main systems along the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919814/7126673463c0059d93d05de586467913a96641f1.gif

- As you progress through the story, your goal will sometimes depend on which ship you choose to use, the cruiser or the fighter. Thus, you'll be able to switch between Scroll Shooter, Top Down Shooter, or Tube Shooter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919814/67404865ef8a6118dcf79f303fca6420a8dc5860.gif

- Leveling system that is divided into three blocks:

 With the help of auxiliary systems improvement, you will be able to strengthen the hull of your cruiser; increase the maximum energy or shield reserve, as well as improve the auxiliary turret and stationary drones, which operate automatically.
 The Hangar gives you the ability to create and improve unmanned fighters in various ways, from decreasing the time it takes for new fighters to be created, to unlocking new and deadly models.
 The Armory allows you to upgrade your cruiser's main guns - the Blaster, Big Bertha, and Shotgun. Unlock burst projectiles or increase the fire rate. Alternatively, you can simply increase damage.
.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919814/6979d5e7b50d358c9e029a1e6875de49afcdfa81.gif

Leveling is practically unlimited, but since each level can only be completed once, experience gained for leveling up can only be obtained once as well, it won't be possible to access all upgrades during the prologue. Moreover, new weapons and perks are unlocked later in the story, after the prologue is completed.

- The prologue's progress is carried over to the main game automatically.

- An added bonus! 
As a reward for completing the prologue, you'll receive a unique weapon for your cruiser in the main game. Be sure to check what's inside this glowing box!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919814/60746500981e080f12d4ed239646753ef363831f.gif

Good luck in space battles!

We'll announce the release date for the prologue soon.
